services.desc: Our recent rockfish charter was an unforgettable experience. We spent the day reeling in big and feisty Striped Bass, and the weather and water conditions were just right for a successful day out on the water. Starting early in the morning, we quickly started getting bites left and right. It was a thrill to see the Striped Bass leaping out of the water as we reeled them in. Throughout the day, we caught plenty of fish, and our clients were ecstatic with their catch. All in all, it was a fantastic day out on the water, and we can't wait to get back out there and do it all over again! Book your next rockfish charter now for your chance to experience the thrill of fishing in Chesapeake Bay.
